warmup.footnote: Only in the first N months (configuration preisschritt_elastizitaet_ab): per boundary the step r_k relative to the previous month's price; no alignment of annual ECU BudgetJ target to the effective simulated annual target. Columns: monthly sum p·VET target, reference ecumenge_ziel_sim/12 (after ratchet if any), monthly deviation and annualized (12·Δ month).

yearly_ecu.footnote: Annual ECU BudgetJ target (bundle) = annual value Σ p_i·budget_J_i at the price vector at year end (account framework). In the “ECU accounts” chart the same quantity is also shown as a monthly share (÷12) alongside actual and reference lines. Slack = annual Σ ecu_preis·BudgetJ target minus configured ecumenge_ziel — zero under exact normalization; on the soft path it may differ from 0 (gradual approach to simulated annual budget ecumenge_ziel_sim). Chart “ECU accounts”: ecumenge_ziel_sim (month) and ecumenge_T are separate curves (ecumenge_T = simulated monthly outflow for Σ p·c; may differ from the ratchet monthly share, e.g. in the first month). Mean util. = mean of NutzungT / VET target per boundary (can be > 1).
